meta.includedFields: 306 base-game community +0 references; 101 DLC +0 source-backed base records (both individual pages and category-comparison table records); only Stone-Sheathed Sword retains source-conflicted unknown +0 attack; all 102 DLC have cited requirements and weight; 6 published rounded somber base attack progressions, zero precise current-regulation AR profiles. Added 8 Tarnished Pack/Tarnished Edition source-named armaments in 1.17 with patch-labelled 1.17.3 community requirement/weight facts; +0 attack, critical, scaling and AR deliberately UNKNOWN. Added 3 individual 2026 Tarnished Pack published +0 wiki base figures; not independently patch-verified. Madding Hand still has community FAI 13 vs pinned V1.17 FAI 20, now independently corroborated as FAI 20 in current Regulation 1.17.3 secondary reference; no game menu screenshot. Four more Pack +0 community table references (Reverse-Bladed Sword, Hefty Scimitar, Leontiel's Greatsword, Golden Order Flail). Ritual Thrusting Shield +0 remains unknown and secondary source weight/requirements differ; wield and equipped-weight functions block its disputed fields. Six existing source-disputed +0 attack rows now carry separate unversioned third-party Base vectors matching pinned v1.17, strictly as provisional evidence; not changed as authoritative attacks or unlocked for AR.
meta.corrections: Royal Greatsword, Serpentbone Blade and Star Fist have individually cross-checked numeric corrections; all other records are community source values. Twelve entries retain '?' scaling grades from the source and are flagged rather than guessed. DLC records have no invented attack/weight/scaling. This is a partial selection of DLC armaments, not a complete expansion catalog. Expanded Shadow of the Erdtree list to 102 entries (weapons and shields) using an attributed expansion roster; 9 individual +0 records separately checked with Eldenpedia. DLC upgrade factors, elemental correction curves and affinity profiles are not supplied or verified; zero AR-calculable DLC records. Sourced 9 additional DLC +0 rows from their exact wiki.gg weapon pages; three published +0–+10 base-attack tables are saved separately. These rounded tables do not imply precise reinforcement multipliers. Added three source-attributed +0 facts: Spread Crossbow, Spirit Sword and Tooth Whip; Tooth Whip's 11-step somber integer base-attack progression is independently linked. These do not imply full AR verification. Corrected Spiked Spear's malformed upstream Dexterity 0 to required 16 and critical 0 to 100, independently sourced against Eldenpedia's base-game weapon page; ranged crossbow two-hand Strength requirement handling updated with source examples. Added nine individually source-checked DLC +0 records (including 1.17 Black Steel Greatshield weight, Carian Sorcery Sword critical, and corrected Ansbach Longbow DEX 43) and Euporia +0..+10 reported somber BASE attack. No AR multiplier inferred. Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword source upgrade row +3 has an anomalous magic value, so no reinforcement table is imported for it. 2026-10-30: Added 13 individually sourced DLC +0 records including patch-1.17 perfume values; all 102 DLC requirements and source-reported weapon weights now populated. The remaining 59 weight/requirements records are secondary-source observations, not game-verified current regulation. Carian Sorcery Sword physical +0 corrected from 69 to 38 per independent regulation 1.17 patch diff. Barbed Staff-Spear and Claws of Night source-published upgrade tables contain nonmonotonic/conflicting values and were deliberately not imported. 2026-10-30 later: 14 further individually cited DLC +0 facts. Secondary weight mismatch corrected against per-weapon wiki.gg for Staff of the Great Beyond and Golem Fist. Radahn paired greatsword two-hand STR requirement may receive documented 1.5x bonus while player AR remains unverified. Stone-Sheathed Sword wiki infobox physical 119 conflicts with its upgrading table +0 89; this record remains attack UNKNOWN pending a better primary/reference cross-check. Added seven per-weapon wiki.gg +0 records (Dancing Blade of Ranah, Curseblade's Cirque, both Death Knight Axes, Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear, Horned Warrior's Greatsword and Flowerstone Gavel), and Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear sourced +0..+10 base progression. Stone-Sheathed Sword weight corrected 5 to 3.5 from wiki.gg Straight Swords list; its contradictory base attack remains UNKNOWN. Additional 37 DLC +0 entries sourced from wiki.gg category comparison tables or named weapon pages; explicit source URL and category-table source-quality flag per record. Fixed Madding Hand Faith requirement 20 to source 13, Main-gauche weight 2.5 to sourced 2. Messmer Soldier's Spear and Swift Spear list malformed Faith grade 0 (left as '?' not guessed); Falx wiki +0 Strength scaling disagrees between stat display and somber table (left '?' with conflict flag). Only Stone-Sheathed Sword remains unknown attack because wiki +0 physical base 119 versus upgrade table 89. No claimed AR or infusions. Separate independent source-vs-source audit against pinned ThomasJClark 1.17 regulation finds 6 +0 attack conflicts and 1 Madding Hand FAI requirement conflict. Corrected +0 interpretation multiplies raw attack by level-0 reinforce attack multiplier; the wiki values and 1.17 values are NOT silently reconciled. These seven records have prominent caution flags pending game-version-specific verification. 2026-10-31 catalog source-name normalization: corrected three original community labels (Prince of Death's Staff, Sword of St. Trina, Velvet Sword of St. Trina) while preserving stable weapon IDs. Dropped original Closed Network Test-only Winged Spear as a separate record: its finished-game equivalent is Spear (already represented), and its 78 physical base should NOT be mapped to released Spear's 114. Independent pinned 1.17 weapon-family audit finds all 408 retained community records have a normalized exact base-family name in the 3296-variant source. This is name coverage, not stat/patch validation. 2026-10-31: Source-backed Tarnished Pack/Tarnished Edition 8-armament roster added: seven weapons and Silver Grooved Shield. Requirements and weights attributed to Almanauts build 25827938, Regulation 1.17.3, not individually authenticated in game. +0 base attacks/crit/scaling remain null. New item names corroborated by GamesRadar and player-oriented references. 2026-10-31: Idus Sword, Reed Great Katana, Silver Grooved Shield +0 attacks/critical/base scaling cited to individually named wiki.gg weapon pages; original source-not-game-certified, and patch-labelled 1.17.3 weights/requirements retained. Separate current patch 1.17.3 secondary Madding Hand requirements STR8/DEX8/INT13/FAI20/ARC0 corroborate pinned V1.17 but legacy wiki gives FAI13, so unresolved-game flag retained. 2026-10-31: Added exact class-table +0 numbers from wiki.gg for Reverse-Bladed Sword (115 physical), Hefty Scimitar (135 physical), Leontiel's Greatsword (130 physical), Golden Order Flail (75 physical, 92 holy). Ritual Thrusting Shield remains +0 unknown; cross-publication disagreement in STR requirement (13 vs 15) and weight (10 vs 9) explicitly blocks computation while retaining attributed source values. This is one additional *secondary source* dispute beyond the seven pinned 1.17-vs-community source disputes; no in-game proof. 2026-10-31 six disputed +0 attack vectors checked against tarnished.app individual unversioned Base columns; all six match pinned v1.17 raw report, but source lineage/version unsupported; original conflicts remain and site does not treat them as game-verified.
